opening: I can say little by way of preface to Seneca's "Minor Dialogues" which I have not already expressed in my preface to "De Beneficiis," except that the "Minor Dialogues" seem to me to be composed in a gloomier key than either the "De Beneficiis" or "De Clementia," and probably were written at a time w
about: 스토아 철학자 세네카가 섭리, 현자의 굳건함, 위로, 삶의 짧음 같은 주제를 다룬 짧은 글들을 모은 책이다.
aboutEn:
A collection of shorter essays by the Stoic Seneca on providence, the firmness of the wise man, consolation and the shortness of life.
It shows what Stoic philosophy meant in the age of the Twelve Caesars.

title: 쇼펜하우어 인생론: 삶의 지혜
author: 아르투어 쇼펜하우어
match: The Essays of Arthur Schopenhauer: the Wisdom of Life
opening: In these pages I shall speak of The Wisdom of Life in the common meaning of the term, as the art, namely, of ordering our lives so as to obtain the greatest possible amount of pleasure and success; an art the theory of which may be called Eudaemonology, for it teaches us how to lead a happy existenc
about: 쇼펜하우어가 행복하게 사는 기술을 논하며, 사람의 됨됨이와 재산, 타인의 평가를 나누어 살피는 책이다.
aboutEn:
Schopenhauer treats the art of living happily, weighing what a man is, what he has, and how others regard him.
It is notable for an author who doubts life's worth writing a practical guide to it.

title: 쇼펜하우어 인생론: 조언과 격언
author: 아르투어 쇼펜하우어
match: The Essays of Arthur Schopenhauer; Counsels and Maxims
opening: If my object in these pages were to present a complete scheme of counsels and maxims for the guidance of life, I should have to repeat the numerous rules—some of them excellent—which have been drawn up by thinkers of all ages, from Theognis and Solomon1 down to La Rochefoucauld; and, in so doing, I
about: 쇼펜하우어가 일반 원칙, 자기 자신과의 관계, 타인과의 관계로 나누어 삶의 처신에 대한 조언을 적은 책이다.
aboutEn:
Schopenhauer's collection of practical advice on conduct, grouped under general rules and our relations to ourselves and to others.
Its short numbered sections can be read one at a time and weighed against one's own life.

title: 문명 속의 불만
author: 지크문트 프로이트
opening: The impression forces itself upon one that men measure by false standards, that everyone seeks power, success, riches for himself and admires others who attain them, while undervaluing the truly precious things in life.
about: 프로이트가 종교적 감정의 근원에 대한 친구의 반론에서 출발해, 문명 속에서 인간이 느끼는 불만을 따져 묻는 책이다.
aboutEn:
Freud begins with a friend's objection about the source of religious feeling and goes on to examine human discontent within civilization.
It asks why a society built for our benefit still leaves us unhappy.

title: 무의식의 심리학
author: 카를 구스타프 융
match: Psychology of the Unconscious / A Study of the Transformations and Symbolisms of the Libido. A Contribution to the History of the Evolution of Thought
opening: This book, remarkable for its erudition and the tremendous labor expended upon it, as well as for the new light which it sheds upon human life, its motives, its needs and its possibilities, is not one for desultory reading or superficial examination.
about: 융이 신화와 민간전승을 심리학으로 분석해 고대인과 현대인을 잇는 공통된 욕망을 밝히려 한 책이다.
aboutEn:
Jung applies psychological analysis to mythology and folklore, seeking a common desire that links ancient peoples with modern ones.
It rewards patient reading for its attempt to read myths as a language of the mind.

title: 장자
author: 장자
match: Chuang Tzu: Mystic, Moralist, and Social Reformer
opening: Chuang Tzŭ[1] belongs to the third and fourth centuries before Christ. He lived in the feudal age, when China was split up into a number of States owning a nominal allegiance to the royal, and weakly, House of Chou.
about: 기원전 3~4세기 중국의 사상가 장자가 우화로 풀어낸 도가 사상의 고전이다.
aboutEn: This is a classic of Taoist thought by the fourth-century B.C. Chinese thinker Chuang Tzu, told mostly through allegory.

title: 펠로폰네소스 전쟁사
author: 투키디데스
match: The History of the Peloponnesian War
original: The History of the Peloponnesian War
opening: There is also another circumstance that contributes not a little to my conviction of the weakness of ancient times. Before the Trojan war there is no indication of any common action in Hellas, nor indeed of the universal prevalence of the name; on the contrary, before the time of Hellen, son of Deuc
about: 아테네 출신 투키디데스가 아테네와 펠로폰네소스 동맹 사이의 전쟁을 발발 시점부터 기록한 역사서다.
aboutEn: The Athenian Thucydides records the war between Athens and the Peloponnesians from the moment it broke out.

title: 그리스·로마 신화
author: 토머스 불핀치
match: Bulfinch's Mythology: The Age of Fable
opening: Juno. Syrinx, or Pandean Pipes. Argus's Eyes. Io. Callisto Constellations of Great and Little Bear. Pole-star. Diana. Actaeon. Latona. Rustics turned to Frogs. Isle of Delos. Phaeton. Palace of the Sun. Phoebus. Day. Month. Year. Hours. Seasons. Chariot of the sun. People of Aethiopia.
about: 그리스·로마 신들과 영웅, 변신 이야기를 차례로 모아 풀어 쓴 신화 안내서다.
aboutEn: This guide gathers the gods, heroes and transformation tales of Greek and Roman myth in order.

title: 우파니샤드
author: 작자 미상
opening: The translator's idea of rendering the Upanishads into clear simple English, accessible to Occidental readers, had its origin in a visit paid to a Boston friend in 1909.
about: 고대 산스크리트 원전의 우파니샤드를 서양 독자도 읽기 쉬운 영어로 옮기고 해설을 붙인 책이다.
aboutEn: This is a translation of the ancient Sanskrit Upanishads into clear English, with commentary for Western readers.

title: 무사도
author: 니토베 이나조
opening: "There are, if I may so say, three powerful spirits, which have from time to time, moved on the face of the waters, and given a predominant impulse to the moral sentiments and energies of mankind. These are the spirits of liberty, of religion, and of honor." —Hallam, Europe in the Middle Ages.
about: 니토베 이나조가 일본 무사의 도덕을 서양 독자에게 설명한 책이다.
aboutEn: Inazo Nitobé explains the moral code of the Japanese samurai to Western readers.

title: 법구경
author: 작자 미상
match: Dhammapada, a Collection of Verses; Being One of the Canonical Books of the Buddhists
opening: 1. All that we are is the result of what we have thought: it is founded on our thoughts, it is made up of our thoughts. If a man speaks or acts with an evil thought, pain follows him, as the wheel follows the foot of the ox that draws the carriage. 2.
about: 붓다의 가르침을 짧은 시구로 엮어 장별로 묶은 불교 경전이다.
aboutEn: This Buddhist scripture gathers the Buddha's teachings in short verses arranged by chapter.

title: 바가바드 기타
author: 작자 미상
match: The Song Celestial; Or, Bhagavad-Gîtâ (from the Mahâbhârata) / Being a discourse between Arjuna, Prince of India, and the Supreme Being under the form of Krishna
opening: This famous and marvellous Sanskrit poem occurs as an episode of the Mahabharata, in the sixth--or "Bhishma"--Parva of the great Hindoo epic. It enjoys immense popularity and authority in India, where it is reckoned as one of the ``Five Jewels,"--pancharatnani--of Devanagiri literature.
about: 마하바라타에 실린 아르주나 왕자와 크리슈나의 대화를 영어 시로 옮긴 책이다.
aboutEn: This English verse rendering presents the dialogue between Prince Arjuna and Krishna from the Mahabharata.

title: 오소독시
author: G. K. 체스터턴
opening: I have often had a fancy for writing a romance about an English yachtsman who slightly miscalculated his course and discovered England under the impression that it was a new island in the South Seas.
about: 체스터턴이 자신이 어떻게 기독교 신앙에 이르렀는지를 수수께끼와 그 답의 형식으로 풀어낸 책이다.
aboutEn: Chesterton explains how he personally came to Christian belief, arranging the book as a riddle and its answer.

title: 민주주의와 교육
author: 존 듀이
match: Democracy and Education: An Introduction to the Philosophy of Education
opening: 1. Renewal of Life by Transmission. The most notable distinction between living and inanimate things is that the former maintain themselves by renewal. A stone when struck resists. If its resistance is greater than the force of the blow struck, it remains outwardly unchanged.
about: 존 듀이가 교육을 삶의 필요이자 사회적 기능으로 보고 성장, 훈련, 흥미, 사고를 논한 교육철학서다.
aboutEn: John Dewey treats education as a necessity of life and a social function, discussing growth, discipline, interest and thinking.

title: 도덕감정론
author: 애덤 스미스
match: The Theory of Moral Sentiments / Or, an Essay Towards an Analysis of the Principles by Which Men Naturally Judge Concerning the Conduct and Character, First of Their Neighbours, and Afterwards of Themselves. to Which Is Added, a Dissertation on the Origin of Languages.
opening: An Analysis of the Principles by which Men naturally judge concerning the Conduct and Character, first of their Neighbours, and afterwards of THEMSELVES.
about: 애덤 스미스가 사람이 이웃과 자신의 행위와 성품을 어떻게 판단하는지 공감의 원리로 분석한 책이다.
aboutEn: Adam Smith analyzes how people judge the conduct and character of their neighbours and themselves, through the principle of sympathy.

title: 조선상고사
author: 신채호
opening: 역사란 무엇인가? 인류 사회의 "아(我)"와 "비아(非我)"의 투쟁이 시간으로 발전하고 공간으로 확대되는 심적(心的)활동 상태의 기록이니, 세계사라 하면 세계 인류가 그렇게 되어온 상태의 기록이요, 조선사라 하면 조선 민족이 이렇게 되어온 상태의 기록이다. 무엇을 "아" 라 하며 무엇을 "비아"라 하는가? 깊이 팔 것 없이 얕이 말하자면, 무릇 주관적 위치에 서 있는 자를 아라 하고, 그밖의 것은 비아라 한다.
about: 신채호가 '아'와 '비아'의 투쟁으로 역사를 정의하며 조선 상고시대의 흐름을 서술한 역사서다.
aboutEn: Shin Chaeho defines history as the struggle between 'self' and 'non-self' and narrates ancient Korea's early history.

title: 자조론
author: 새뮤얼 스마일스
match: Self Help; with Illustrations of Conduct and Perseverance
opening: In one respect the title of the book, which it is now too late to alter, has proved unfortunate, as it has led some, who have judged it merely by the title, to suppose that it consists of a eulogy of selfishness: the very opposite of what it really is,—or at least of what the author intended it to b
about: 새뮤얼 스마일스가 여러 인물의 일화를 모아 노력과 품성, 인내를 이야기하는 19세기 교훈서다. 다양한 삶의 사례를 통해 스스로를 일으킨다는 것이 무엇인지 생각해 볼 수 있다.
aboutEn: Samuel Smiles gathers anecdotes of many lives to discuss conduct, character and perseverance in this nineteenth-century book of moral guidance. Its varied examples invite reflection on what it means to improve oneself by one's own effort.

title: 원인과 결과의 법칙
author: 제임스 앨런
opening: THIS little volume (the result of meditation and experience) is not intended as an exhaustive treatise on the much-written-upon subject of the power of thought.
about: 생각이 사람의 성격과 환경, 건강, 성취에 어떤 영향을 주는지 짧게 풀어낸 제임스 앨런의 에세이다. 자신의 생각을 스스로 고르고 가꾼다는 관점을 간결한 글로 접할 수 있다.
aboutEn: James Allen's short essay explores how thought shapes character, circumstances, health and achievement. It offers a concise look at the idea that people make themselves through the thoughts they choose and encourage.

title: 부자가 되는 과학적 방법
author: 월러스 D. 와틀스
opening: This book is pragmatical, not philosophical; a practical manual, not a treatise upon theories. It is intended for the men and women whose most pressing need is for money; who wish to get rich first, and philosophize afterward.
about: 월러스 D. 와틀스가 이론보다 실천을 앞세워 부자가 되는 방법을 설명하는 실용서다. 돈이 급한 독자를 대상으로 쓴 책이라 저자가 어떤 태도와 행동을 권하는지 직접 확인해 볼 수 있다.
aboutEn: Wallace D. Wattles presents a practical manual on getting rich, favoring action over theory. Written for readers in pressing need of money, it lets you see for yourself which attitudes and actions the author recommends.

title: 부자가 되는 길
author: 벤저민 프랭클린
match: Franklin's Way to Wealth; or, "Poor Richard Improved"
opening: "This manual is particularly adapted to the purposes of examination and catechetical instruction, and will be found of the utmost service in weekly grammatical enquiries."
about: 벤저민 프랭클린이 쓴 「부자가 되는 길」을 담은 1800년대 초 영국판 소책자다. 근면과 절약에 관한 프랭클린의 조언이 당시 출판물의 모습과 함께 전해진다는 점이 눈길을 끈다.
aboutEn: This is an early nineteenth-century English edition of Benjamin Franklin's Way to Wealth. It presents his advice on industry and thrift along with the look of the period's publishing, which adds to its interest.

title: 군주론
author: 니콜로 마키아벨리
opening: Nicolo Machiavelli, born at Florence on 3rd May 1469. From 1494 to 1512 held an official post at Florence which included diplomatic missions to various European courts. Imprisoned in Florence, 1512; later exiled and returned to San Casciano. Died at Florence on 22nd June 1527.
about: 마키아벨리가 군주국의 종류와 획득 방법, 군대와 군주의 처신을 장별로 다룬 정치론이다.
aboutEn: Machiavelli surveys kinds of principalities, how they are won and held, and how princes should handle armies and conduct.

title: 유토피아
author: 토머스 모어
opening: Sir Thomas More, son of Sir John More, a justice of the King's Bench, was born in 1478, in Milk Street, in the city of London. After his earlier education at St.
about: 토머스 모어가 라파엘 히슬로데이의 입을 빌려 이상적인 공화국 유토피아의 도시, 생활, 제도를 그린 책이다.
aboutEn: Thomas More, through Raphael Hythloday, describes the ideal commonwealth of Utopia, its towns, way of life and institutions.

title: 리바이어던
author: 토머스 홉스
opening: I have restricted my use of full capitalization to those places where Hobbes used it, except in the chapter headings, which I have fully capitalized, where Hobbes used a mixture of full capitalization and italics.
about: 토머스 홉스가 국가의 질료와 형태, 권력을 세속과 종교 양면에서 논한 정치철학서다.
aboutEn: Thomas Hobbes examines the matter, form and power of a commonwealth, both ecclesiastical and civil.

title: 사회계약론
author: 장 자크 루소
opening: For the study of the great writers and thinkers of the past, historical imagination is the first necessity. Without mentally referring to the environment in which they lived, we cannot hope to penetrate below the inessential and temporary to the absolute and permanent value of their thought.
about: 루소가 사회계약의 관점에서 정치 공동체의 정당한 근거를 따진 책으로, 여기서는 소개글이 달린 번역본이다.
aboutEn: Rousseau examines the legitimate basis of political community through the idea of the social contract, here in an introduced translation.

title: 자유론
author: 존 스튜어트 밀
opening: To the beloved and deplored memory of her who was the inspirer, and in part the author, of all that is best in my writings—the friend and wife whose exalted sense of truth and right was my strongest incitement, and whose approbation was my chief reward—I dedicate this volume.
about: 존 스튜어트 밀이 아내에게 헌정한 책으로, 개인의 자유와 사회가 개인에게 행사할 수 있는 권력의 한계를 다룬다.
aboutEn: Dedicated to his late wife, John Stuart Mill's essay addresses individual liberty and the limits of society's power over the individual.

title: 시민 불복종
author: 헨리 데이비드 소로
match: On the Duty of Civil Disobedience
original: On the Duty of Civil Disobedience
opening: I heartily accept the motto,—"That government is best which governs least;" and I should like to see it acted up to more rapidly and systematically.
about: 1849년 소로가 멕시코 전쟁과 노예제에 맞서, 정부와 개인 양심의 관계를 따진 에세이다.
aboutEn: Written in 1849, this essay by Thoreau weighs the individual conscience against the state, with the Mexican War and slavery as its backdrop.�

title: 공산당 선언
author: 마르크스 · 엥겔스
opening: A spectre is haunting Europe—the spectre of Communism. All the Powers of old Europe have entered into a holy alliance to exorcise this spectre: Pope and Czar, Metternich and Guizot, French Radicals and German police-spies.
about: 마르크스와 엥겔스가 공산주의자의 견해와 목적을 밝히려고 쓴 짧은 정치 선언문이다.
aboutEn: Marx and Engels wrote this short political manifesto to set out the views and aims of the Communists.

title: 여성의 권리 옹호
author: 메리 울스턴크래프트
match: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman / With Strictures on Political and Moral Subjects
original: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman
opening: M. Wollstonecraft was born in 1759. Her father was so great a wanderer, that the place of her birth is uncertain; she supposed, however, it was London, or Epping Forest: at the latter place she spent the first five years of her life.
about: 메리 울스턴크래프트가 여성이 받는 교육과 사회적 지위를 비판하며 쓴 18세기 저작이다.
aboutEn: Mary Wollstonecraft's eighteenth-century work critiques the education and social standing of women.

title: 흑인의 영혼
author: W. E. B. 듀보이스
opening: Herein lie buried many things which if read with patience may show the strange meaning of being black here at the dawning of the Twentieth Century. This meaning is not without interest to you, Gentle Reader; for the problem of the Twentieth Century is the problem of the color line.
about: 듀보이스가 해방 이후 미국 흑인의 삶과 영적 세계를 여러 글로 그려 낸 책이다.
aboutEn: Du Bois's collected essays portray the lives and inner world of Black Americans after emancipation.

title: 상호부조론
author: 표트르 크로폿킨
match: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
original: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
opening: Two aspects of animal life impressed me most during the journeys which I made in my youth in Eastern Siberia and Northern Manchuria.
about: 크로폿킨이 시베리아 탐사 경험을 바탕으로 동물 사회의 협력이 진화에 미친 역할을 논한 책이다.
aboutEn: Drawing on his Siberian travels, Kropotkin argues that cooperation among animals is a factor in evolution.

title: 조선혁명선언
author: 신채호
opening: 강도 일본이 우리의 국호를 없이 하며, 우리의 정권을 빼앗으며, 우리 생존적 필요조건을 다 박탈하였다. 경제의 생명인 산림·천택(川澤)·철도·광산·어장 내지 소공업 원료까지 다 빼앗아 일체의 생산기능을 칼로 베이며 도끼로 끊고, 토지세·가옥세·인구세·가축세·백일세(百一稅)·지방세·주초세(酒草稅)·비료세·종자세·영업세·청결세·소득세―기타 각종 잡세가 날로 증가하여 혈액은 있는대로 다 빨아가고, 어지간한 상업가들은 일본의 제조품을 조선인에게 매개하는 중간인이 되어 차차 자본집중의 원칙하에서 멸망할 뿐이요, 대다수 민중 곧 일반 농민들은
about: 신채호가 일제의 수탈과 폭압을 고발하고 민중 직접 혁명을 주장한 독립운동 선언문이다.
aboutEn: Shin Chaeho's independence manifesto denounces Japanese exploitation and violence and calls for popular revolution.

title: 통치론
author: 존 로크
opening: Digitized by Dave Gowan. John Locke's "Second Treatise of Government" was published in 1690. The complete unabridged text has been republished several times in edited commentaries.
about: 존 로크가 시민 정부의 본래 범위와 목적을 논한 1690년의 정치 철학서다.
aboutEn: John Locke's 1690 treatise on the original extent and purpose of civil government.

title: 미국의 민주주의 1
author: 알렉시 드 토크빌
opening: Amongst the novel objects that attracted my attention during my stay in the United States, nothing struck me more forcibly than the general equality of conditions.
about: 토크빌이 미국의 지리, 기원, 연방 헌법과 인민주권의 작동을 살핀 책이다.
aboutEn: Tocqueville examines America's geography, origins, federal constitution, and the workings of popular sovereignty.

title: 미국의 민주주의 2
author: 알렉시 드 토크빌
opening: I must at once warn the reader against an error which would be extremely prejudicial to me. When he finds that I attribute so many different consequences to the principle of equality, he may thence infer that I consider that principle to be the sole cause of all that takes place in the present age:
about: 토크빌이 민주주의가 미국인의 사고방식, 종교, 예술, 문학, 감정에 미치는 영향을 살피는 『미국의 민주주의』 두 번째 권이다.
aboutEn: The second volume of Tocqueville's Democracy in America examines how democracy shapes Americans' thought, religion, arts, literature and feelings.

title: 여성의 종속
author: 존 스튜어트 밀
opening: The object of this Essay is to explain as clearly as I am able, the grounds of an opinion which I have held from the very earliest period when I had formed any opinions at all on social or political matters, and which, instead of being weakened or modified, has been constantly growing stronger by th
about: 밀이 남녀 간의 법적 종속을 그 자체로 그릇되다고 보고 완전한 평등으로 바꿔야 한다고 논증하는 에세이다.
aboutEn: Mill's essay argues that the legal subordination of one sex to the other is wrong and should give way to perfect equality.

title: 아나키즘
author: 엠마 골드만
opening: Propagandism is not, as some suppose, a "trade," because nobody will follow a "trade" at which you may work with the industry of a slave and die with the reputation of a mendicant.
about: 엠마 골드만이 아나키즘, 애국주의, 감옥, 청교도주의, 여성 해방 등을 다룬 에세이를 묶은 책이다.
aboutEn: A collection of Emma Goldman's essays on anarchism, patriotism, prisons, puritanism, women's emancipation and more.

title: 상식
author: 토머스 페인
opening: A new edition, with several additions in the body of the work. To which is added an appendix; together with an address to the people called Quakers. Man knows no Master save creating Heaven Or those whom choice and common good ordain. Thomson.
about: 페인이 정부의 기원과 군주제, 세습을 비판하고 영국에 맞선 미국의 처지를 논하는 1776년의 소책자다.
aboutEn: Paine's 1776 pamphlet criticizes monarchy and hereditary rule and addresses America's situation against Britain.

title: 페더럴리스트
author: 해밀턴 · 매디슨 · 제이
opening: FEDERALIST No. 27. The Same Subject Continued (The Idea of Restraining the Legislative Authority in Regard to the Common Defense Considered) FEDERALIST No. 28. The Same Subject Continued (The Idea of Restraining the Legislative Authority in Regard to the Common Defense Considered) FEDERALIST No.
about: 해밀턴, 매디슨, 제이가 새 미국 헌법의 비준을 설득하려고 쓴 논설 모음이다.
aboutEn: A collection of essays by Hamilton, Madison and Jay written to persuade readers to ratify the new U.S. Constitution.

title: 국부론
author: 애덤 스미스
match: An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations
opening: The annual labour of every nation is the fund which originally supplies it with all the necessaries and conveniencies of life which it annually consumes, and which consist always either in the immediate produce of that labour, or in what is purchased with that produce from other nations.
about: 애덤 스미스가 분업, 화폐, 가격, 임금, 이윤, 자본 축적을 차례로 설명하는 경제학의 고전이다.
aboutEn: Adam Smith's classic of economics explains the division of labour, money, prices, wages, profit and the accumulation of capital.

title: 유한계급론
author: 소스타인 베블런
match: The Theory of the Leisure Class
original: The Theory of the Leisure Class
opening: The institution of a leisure class is found in its best development at the higher stages of the barbarian culture; as, for instance, in feudal Europe or feudal Japan.
about: 베블런이 유한계급의 제도를 출발점으로 과시적 여가와 과시적 소비 같은 경제 행태를 분석한 책이다.
aboutEn: Veblen starts from the institution of the leisure class to analyze conspicuous leisure, conspicuous consumption and related economic behavior.

title: 인구론
author: 토머스 맬서스
match: An Essay on the Principle of Population
original: An Essay on the Principle of Population
opening: The following Essay owes its origin to a conversation with a friend, on the subject of Mr Godwin's essay on avarice and profusion, in his Enquirer.
about: 토머스 맬서스가 1798년에 펴낸 글로, 인구 원리가 사회의 장래 개선에 미치는 영향을 다루며 고드윈과 콩도르세의 주장에 반론을 편다. 당대 낙관론과 맞선 논쟁의 출발점을 원문으로 읽어 볼 수 있다.
aboutEn: Published in 1798, Thomas Malthus's essay examines how the principle of population affects the future improvement of society, responding to the speculations of Godwin and Condorcet. It lets you read the starting point of a famous debate with the optimists of his day.

title: 정치경제학과 과세의 원리
author: 데이비드 리카도
match: On The Principles of Political Economy, and Taxation
original: On the Principles of Political Economy, and Taxation
opening: The produce of the earth—all that is derived from its surface by the united application of labour, machinery, and capital, is divided among three classes of the community; namely, the proprietor of the land, the owner of the stock or capital necessary for its cultivation, and the labourers by whose
about: 서문에서 분배 법칙을 정치경제학의 핵심 문제로 꼽아, 과세의 영향까지 분배에서 풀어 가는 논리를 따라가 볼 수 있다.
aboutEn: Its opening names distribution as the central problem of political economy, so you can follow how taxation is reasoned out from that starting point.

title: 평화의 경제적 결과
author: 존 메이너드 케인스
match: The Economic Consequences of the Peace
original: The Economic Consequences of the Peace
opening: The power to become habituated to his surroundings is a marked characteristic of mankind. Very few of us realize with conviction the intensely unusual, unstable, complicated, unreliable, temporary nature of the economic organization by which Western Europe has lived for the last half century.
about: 전쟁 전 유럽의 경제 질서가 얼마나 불안정한 토대 위에 있었는지 되짚게 하는 첫머리가 볼만하다.
aboutEn: Its opening, which shows how fragile Europe's prewar economic order was, is worth reading for how it makes us rethink what we take for granted.

title: 종의 기원
author: 찰스 다윈
match: On the Origin of Species By Means of Natural Selection / Or, the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life
opening: "But with regard to the material world, we can at least go so far as this—we can perceive that events are brought about not by insulated interpositions of Divine power, exerted in each particular case, but by the establishment of general laws." W. WHEWELL: Bridgewater Treatise.
about: 가축과 재배 식물의 변이에서 출발해 생존경쟁과 지질 기록의 한계까지 논증이 이어지는 순서를 따라가 볼 만하다.
aboutEn: The argument begins with variation in domestic animals and plants and moves on to the struggle for existence and the gaps in the geological record, a sequence worth following.

title: 상대성 이론
author: 알베르트 아인슈타인
match: Relativity : the Special and General Theory
original: Relativity: The Special and General Theory
opening: In your schooldays most of you who read this book made acquaintance with the noble building of Euclid's geometry, and you remember—perhaps with more respect than love—the magnificent structure, on the lofty staircase of which you were chased about for uncounted hours by conscientious teachers.
about: 좌표계와 동시성, 시간 개념 같은 기본 물음에서 출발해 이론이 쌓이는 과정을 이론의 창시자의 설명으로 따라갈 수 있다.
aboutEn: It starts from basic questions about co-ordinate systems, simultaneity, and time, letting you follow the theory's build-up in its originator's own words.

title: 비글호 항해기
author: 찰스 다윈
opening: I have myself published separate volumes on the 'Structure and Distribution of Coral Reefs;' on the 'Volcanic Islands visited during the Voyage of the Beagle;' and on the 'Geology of South America.' The sixth volume of the 'Geological Transactions' contains two papers of mine on the Erratic Boulders
about: 지진과 산맥, 산호초, 원주민과 동식물까지 젊은 박물학자의 눈에 비친 세계를 장별 여정으로 따라갈 수 있다.
aboutEn: Chapter by chapter you see earthquakes, mountains, coral reefs, peoples, and wildlife through the eyes of a young naturalist.

title: 인간의 유래
author: 찰스 다윈
match: The Descent of Man, and Selection in Relation to Sex
opening: Nature of the evidence bearing on the origin of man—Homologous structures in man and the lower animals—Miscellaneous points of correspondence—Development—Rudimentary structures, muscles, sense-organs, hair, bones, reproductive organs, etc.—The bearing of these three great classes of facts on the ori
about: 인간과 동물의 정신 능력을 비교하고, 곤충·조류·포유류의 이차 성징을 차례로 짚는 구성이 볼만하다.
aboutEn: It compares the mental powers of humans and animals, then takes up the secondary sexual characters of insects, birds, and mammals in turn.

title: 촛불의 과학
author: 마이클 패러데이
match: The Chemical History of a Candle
original: The Chemical History of a Candle
opening: From the primitive pine-torch to the paraffin candle, how wide an interval! between them how vast a contrast! The means adopted by man to illuminate his home at night, stamp at once his position in the scale of civilisation.
about: 작은 촛불 하나에서 불과 연소의 원리를 풀어 가는 방식이어서, 일상의 현상을 과학으로 바라보게 한다.
aboutEn: By unfolding the principles of fire and burning from one small candle, it invites you to look at everyday things scientifically.

title: 거미의 생활 (파브르 곤충기)
author: 장앙리 파브르
opening: The Spider has a bad name: to most of us, she represents an odious, noxious animal, which every one hastens to crush under foot.
about: 혐오의 대상인 거미의 독과 솜씨를 차분히 따져 보는 첫머리에서, 편견을 되돌아보게 된다.
aboutEn: Its opening calmly weighs the spider's poison and skill, prompting a second look at our prejudice against it.

title: 인간과 동물의 감정 표현
author: 찰스 다윈
match: The Expression of the Emotions in Man and Animals
original: The Expression of the Emotions in Man and Animals
opening: N.B.—Several of the figures in these seven Heliotype Plates have been reproduced from photographs, instead of from the original negatives; and they are in consequence somewhat indistinct.
about: 다윈이 사람과 동물이 얼굴과 몸짓으로 감정을 드러내는 방식을 관찰하고 그 일반 원리를 따지는 책이다.
aboutEn: Darwin observes how humans and animals show emotion through face and posture, and sets out the general principles behind it.

title: 보물섬
author: 로버트 루이스 스티븐슨
opening: Squire Trelawney, Dr. Livesey, and the rest of these gentlemen having asked me to write down the whole particulars about Treasure Island, from the beginning to the end, keeping nothing back but the bearings of the island, and that only because there is still treasure not yet lifted, I take up my pen
about: 여관 '애드미럴 벤보'에 늙은 해적이 나타나면서 시작되는 바다 모험담으로, 보물과 해적이 얽힌다.
aboutEn: A sea adventure of buccaneers and buried gold that begins when an old sailor turns up at the Admiral Benbow inn.

title: 이상한 나라의 앨리스
author: 루이스 캐럴
opening: So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.
about: 지루해하던 앨리스가 시계를 꺼내 보는 흰 토끼를 쫓아 토끼굴로 떨어지며 시작되는 환상 이야기다.
aboutEn: Bored Alice follows a White Rabbit who consults a pocket watch, and tumbles down its hole into a fantastic tale.

title: 피터 팬
author: J. M. 배리
opening: All children, except one, grow up. They soon know that they will grow up, and the way Wendy knew was this. One day when she was two years old she was playing in a garden, and she plucked another flower and ran with it to her mother. I suppose she must have looked rather delightful, for Mrs.
about: 런던의 달링 가족과 딸 웬디, 그리고 자라지 않는 소년 피터를 다루는 이야기다.
aboutEn: A story about the Darling family of London, their daughter Wendy, and Peter, the boy who does not grow up.

title: 오즈의 마법사
author: L. 프랭크 바움
opening: Folklore, legends, myths and fairy tales have followed childhood through the ages, for every healthy youngster has a wholesome and instinctive love for stories fantastic, marvelous and manifestly unreal.
about: 회오리바람에 휩쓸린 소녀 도로시가 낯선 오즈의 나라에서 허수아비, 양철 나무꾼, 사자와 길을 떠나는 동화다.
aboutEn: A fairy tale in which a cyclone carries the girl Dorothy to the strange land of Oz, where she travels with a Scarecrow, a Tin Woodman and a Lion.

title: 빨간 머리 앤
author: 루시 모드 몽고메리
opening: MRS. Rachel Lynde lived just where the Avonlea main road dipped down into a little hollow, fringed with alders and ladies' eardrops and traversed by a brook that had its source away back in the woods of the old Cuthbert place; it was reputed to be an intricate, headlong brook in its earlier course t
about: 초록 지붕 집의 남매가 고아 소년을 기다리다 뜻밖의 아이를 맞이하며 시작되는 성장 이야기다.
aboutEn: A coming-of-age story that begins when an elderly brother and sister at Green Gables receive an unexpected child.

title: 비밀의 화원
author: 프랜시스 호지슨 버넷
opening: One frightfully hot morning, when she was about nine years old, she awakened feeling very cross, and she became crosser still when she saw that the servant who stood by her bedside was not her Ayah. "Why did you come?" she said to the strange woman. "I will not let you stay.
about: 인도에서 부모를 잃은 메리 레녹스가 영국 미슬스웨이트 저택의 외삼촌에게 보내지는 이야기다.
aboutEn: Mary Lennox, left alone in India, is sent to live with her uncle at Misselthwaite Manor in England.

title: 정글북
author: 러디어드 키플링
opening: It was seven o'clock of a very warm evening in the Seeonee hills when Father Wolf woke up from his day's rest, scratched himself, yawned, and spread out his paws one after the other to get rid of the sleepy feeling in their tips.
about: 인도 시오니 언덕의 늑대 가족과 정글의 동물들이 등장하는 이야기 모음으로, 정글의 법칙이 중심에 놓인다.
aboutEn: A collection of tales about a wolf family and other creatures of the Indian jungle, centered on the Law of the Jungle.

title: 그림 동화
author: 그림 형제
opening: A certain king had a beautiful garden, and in the garden stood a tree which bore golden apples. These apples were always counted, and about the time when they began to grow ripe it was found that every night one of them was gone.
about: 그림 형제가 모은 민담을 엮은 책으로, 여행하는 악사들과 늑대와 일곱 마리 아기 염소 같은 이야기가 실려 있다.
aboutEn: This collection of folk tales gathered by the Brothers Grimm includes stories such as the travelling musicians and the wolf and the seven little kids.

title: 이솝 우화
author: 이솝
match: Three hundred Aesop's fables / Translated by George Fyler Townsend
opening: The continual observance of this twofold aim creates the charm, and accounts for the universal favour, of the fables of Æsop. "The fable," says Professor K. O. Mueller, "originated in Greece in an intentional travestie of human affairs.
about: 사자와 생쥐, 토끼와 거북 같은 동물이 등장하는 짧은 우화를 모은 책이다.
aboutEn: This is a collection of short fables with animals, such as the lion and the mouse and the hare and the tortoise.

title: 만년 셔츠
author: 방정환
opening: 선생님이 두 번씩 연거푸 물어도 손 드는 학생이 없더니, 별안간 '옛' 소리를 지르면서, 기운 좋게 손을 든 사람이 있었다. "음, 창남인가. 어디 말해 보아." "이 없는 동물은 늙은 영감입니다!" "예에끼!" 하고, 선생은 소리를 질렀다. 온 방안 학생이 깔깔거리고 웃어도, 창남이는 태평으로 자리에 앉았다. 수신(도덕) 시간이었다.
about: 익살스러운 학생 창남이가 학교에서 인기를 얻는 모습을 그린 방정환의 소년 소설이다.
aboutEn: Bang Jeong-hwan's story follows Changnam, a cheerful and witty schoolboy who is the most popular student in his class.

title: 동생을 찾으러
author: 방정환
opening: 창호의 누이동생 순희가 별안간에 없어져서, 소동이 생긴 지도 벌써 이레째가 되었습니다. 어머니, 아주머니, 늙으신 할머니, 시집간 누나까지 모두 나서서 아는 집, 일갓집마다 찾아 헤매고 아버지, 아저씨와 외삼촌까지 길에서만 살면서 경찰서에 가서 찾아 달라고 수색 청원도 하고 별별 곳을 모두 돌아다니면서 아무리 찾기에 애를 썼으나, 벌써 이레째 되는 지금까지 아무 소식도 없어서 집안이 난리 난 집 같았습니다.
about: 누이동생 순희가 갑자기 사라져 온 집안이 찾아 헤매는 이야기를 다룬 방정환의 소년 소설이다.
aboutEn: Bang Jeong-hwan's story begins when a girl, Sunhui, suddenly vanishes and her whole family searches for her.

title: 칠칠단의 비밀
author: 방정환
opening: 여러 가지 꽃들이 만발해서, 온 장안 사람이 꽃에 취할 때였습니다. 서울 명동 진고개 어귀에는 며칠 전에 새로 온 곡마단의 재주가 서울 왔다 간 곡마단 중에 제일 재미있고 제일 신기하다 하여, 동물원 구경보다 더 많은 사람이 낮과 밤으로 그칠 새 없이 들이밀려서 들어가지 못하고 도로 돌아가는 이가 더 많을 지경이었습니다.
about: 서울에 온 곡마단에서 재주를 부리는 소년과 소녀를 중심으로 이야기가 시작되는 방정환의 소년 탐정 소설이다.
aboutEn: Bang Jeong-hwan's adventure tale begins with a boy and girl who perform in a circus that has come to Seoul.

title: 키다리 아저씨
author: 진 웹스터
opening: The first Wednesday in every month was a Perfectly Awful Day—a day to be awaited with dread, endured with courage and forgotten with haste. Every floor must be spotless, every chair dustless, and every bed without a wrinkle.
about: 고아원에서 가장 나이 많은 고아 제루샤 애벗의 생활을 그린 진 웹스터의 소설이다.
aboutEn: Jean Webster's novel follows Jerusha Abbott, the oldest orphan in an orphan asylum, through her daily life.

title: 소공녀
author: 프랜시스 호지슨 버넷
match: A Little Princess / Being the whole story of Sara Crewe now told for the first time
opening: Summary: Sara Crewe, a pupil at Miss Minchin's London school, is left in poverty when her father dies, but is later rescued by a mysterious benefactor.
about: 아버지를 잃고 가난해진 소녀 세라 크루가 런던의 기숙학교에서 지내는 이야기를 담은 소설이다.
aboutEn: This novel tells of Sara Crewe, a pupil at a London boarding school who is left in poverty when her father dies.

title: 행복한 왕자
author: 오스카 와일드
match: The Happy Prince, and Other Tales
original: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
opening: High above the city, on a tall column, stood the statue of the Happy Prince. He was gilded all over with thin leaves of fine gold, for eyes he had two bright sapphires, and a large red ruby glowed on his sword-hilt. He was very much admired indeed.
about: 도시의 높은 기둥 위에 선 행복한 왕자 동상과 제비 한 마리가 나오는 오스카 와일드의 동화집이다.
aboutEn: Oscar Wilde's collection of tales opens with the statue of the Happy Prince high above a city and a little Swallow.

title: 곰돌이 푸
author: A. A. 밀른
opening: In a drawing that appears before the start of the story, Pooh stares down at a bath mat, scratching his head with one paw. He seems puzzled.
about: 크리스토퍼 로빈과 곰 인형 위니 더 푸가 숲에서 벌이는 일상을 그린 어린이 이야기다.
aboutEn:
This children's story follows Christopher Robin and his teddy bear Winnie-the-Pooh through their everyday doings in the forest.
The opening explains how Pooh got his name, a playful bit of storytelling that shows the book's gentle humor.

title: 톰 소여의 모험
author: 마크 트웨인
match: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, Complete
opening: CHAPTER XXXIII. The Fate of Injun Joe—Huck and Tom Compare Notes—An Expedition to the Cave—Protection Against Ghosts—"An Awful Snug Place"—A Reception at the Widow Douglas's CHAPTER XXXIV. Springing a Secret—Mr. Jones' Surprise a Failure CHAPTER XXXV.
about: 미시시피 강변 마을에서 이모 폴리와 사는 장난꾸러기 소년 톰 소여의 모험을 다룬 소설이다.
aboutEn:
This novel tells of Tom Sawyer, a mischievous boy living with his Aunt Polly in a town on the Mississippi.
The chapter summaries promise pranks, pirates and a graveyard secret, so you can see what kind of boyhood the book offers.

title: 거울 나라의 앨리스
author: 루이스 캐럴
opening: One thing was certain, that the white kitten had had nothing to do with it:—it was the black kitten's fault entirely. For the white kitten had been having its face washed by the old cat for the last quarter of an hour (and bearing it pretty well, considering); so you see that it couldn't have had an
about: 체스판 위의 말처럼 움직이며 거울 속 세계를 지나가는 앨리스의 이야기다.
aboutEn:
This is the story of Alice moving through a looking-glass world laid out like a chessboard, with her as a pawn.
The opening chess diagram shows that the story follows a game's moves, which makes the book worth reading for its design.

title: 버드나무에 부는 바람
author: 케네스 그레이엄
opening: The Mole had been working very hard all the morning, spring-cleaning his little home. First with brooms, then with dusters; then on ladders and steps and chairs, with a brush and a pail of whitewash; till he had dust in his throat and eyes, and splashes of whitewash all over his black fur, and an ac
about: 봄맞이 대청소에 지친 두더지가 집을 뛰쳐나와 강둑으로 나가면서 시작되는 동물들의 이야기다.
aboutEn:
This tale of animal friends begins when a worn-out Mole abandons his spring-cleaning and bolts out into the sunlit meadow.
Its chapter titles hint at river, road and wild wood, and the opening shows how closely the author observes the countryside.

title: 에이번리의 앤
author: 루시 모드 몽고메리
opening: A tall, slim girl, "half-past sixteen," with serious gray eyes and hair which her friends called auburn, had sat down on the broad red sandstone doorstep of a Prince Edward Island farmhouse one ripe afternoon in August, firmly resolved to construe so many lines of Virgil.
about: 프린스 에드워드 섬에서 열여섯 살 즈음의 앤이 교사가 되어 마을 사람들과 부대끼는 이야기다.
aboutEn:
This novel follows Anne, a girl of about sixteen on Prince Edward Island, as she becomes a schoolteacher and deals with her neighbors.
The chapter titles promise small-town scrapes and friendships, so it suits readers who like a close look at village life.

title: 폴리애나
author: 엘리너 H. 포터
opening: Miss Polly Harrington entered her kitchen a little hurriedly this June morning. Miss Polly did not usually make hurried movements; she specially prided herself on her repose of manner. But to-day she was hurrying—actually hurrying. Nancy, washing dishes at the sink, looked up in surprise.
about: 폴리 해링턴 이모의 집에 어린 폴리애나가 오면서 벌어지는 일을 그린 소설이다.
aboutEn:
This novel centers on the arrival of the young Pollyanna at the house of her aunt, Miss Polly Harrington.
Its opening sets a strict, hurried aunt beside a servant's surprise, which makes you curious how the household will change.

title: 블랙 뷰티
author: 애나 슈얼
opening: The first place that I can well remember was a large pleasant meadow with a pond of clear water in it. Some shady trees leaned over it, and rushes and water-lilies grew at the deep end.
about: 말 한 마리가 자기 삶을 직접 들려주는 자서전 형식의 소설로, 넓은 목장의 기억에서 시작한다.
aboutEn:
This novel is a horse's own autobiography, beginning with his earliest memories of a pleasant meadow with a pond.
Told from the horse's point of view, it invites you to think about how people treat the animals who work for them.

title: 벨벳 토끼
author: 마저리 윌리엄스
opening: detail HERE was once a velveteen rabbit, and in the beginning he was really splendid. He was fat and bunchy, as a rabbit should be; his coat was spotted brown and white, he had real thread whiskers, and his ears were lined with pink sateen.
about: 크리스마스 아침에 소년의 선물로 온 벨벳 토끼 인형이 장난감 방에서 지내는 이야기다.
aboutEn:
This story follows a velveteen toy rabbit who arrives in a boy's Christmas stocking and then lives among the other nursery toys.
It is short, and its opening scenes of a shy toy raise the question of what it means to be real.

title: 안데르센 동화
author: 한스 크리스티안 안데르센
opening: Many years ago, there was an Emperor, who was so excessively fond of new clothes, that he spent all his money in dress. He did not trouble himself in the least about his soldiers; nor did he care to go either to the theatre or the chase, except for the opportunities then afforded him for displaying
about: 첫 이야기는 새 옷에 빠진 황제가 직공을 자처한 사기꾼 둘에게 옷감을 맡기는 대목에서 시작해 허영을 돌아보게 한다.
aboutEn: The first tale opens with a clothes-mad Emperor who hires two rogues posing as weavers, inviting a look at vanity.

title: 밤비
author: 펠릭스 잘텐
opening: He came into the world in the middle of the thicket, in one of those little, hidden forest glades which seem to be entirely open, but are really screened in on all sides. There was very little room in it, scarcely enough for him and his mother.
about: 어린 사슴의 눈으로 숲의 동물과 계절의 흐름을 따라가며 숲에서 살아가는 일을 생각해 보게 된다.
aboutEn: Seen through a young deer's eyes, the forest animals and passing seasons invite thought about what it means to live in the wild.
